title: Kernel PhaseAdvisor: hybrid offline+online autotuner for phase-aware kernel selection
creator: Maya Chen
description: Motivation: current kernel selection uses static heuristics and lightweight bandit probing that struggle with mixed-burst conversational workloads. We observe latency spikes when batch composition shifts mid-request (e.g., long prefill then short decode) or when heterogeneous GPU instances return different microbenchmark profiles. Goal: build a hybrid offline+online system (PhaseAdvisor) that reasons about token-phase (prefill vs decode), sequence-length distributions, and per-device microbench fingerprints to choose kernels and warmstart strategies with strong safety fallbacks.
background_and_notes: Key observations from recent incidents: 1) Prefill-heavy requests on chiplet GPUs favored an attention implementation with lower occupancy but worse tail latency under burst. 2) Short-decode bursts are suboptimal when warmed to the wrong kernel during prefill. 3) Kernel microbenchmarks drifted across driver updates, causing suboptimal choices. PhaseAdvisor will combine: (a) offline profiling catalog keyed by (arch, driver, model-shape, seqlen-bucket), (b) a lightweight online probe during safe windows to validate local perf, and (c) token-phase switchpoints to consider different kernels for prefill vs decode and to orchestrate a safe kernel handoff with minimal KV-snapshot churn.
acceptance_criteria: PhaseAdvisor exists as a runtime component that suggests a primary and secondary kernel for each request based on arch and seqlen histogram
End-to-end experiments show >=6% median cost reduction or >=8% median latency improvement on mixed conversational workloads compared to baseline heuristics
Safe fallback policy defined: if online probe fails or latency exceeds threshold, revert to conservative kernel and record telemetry
Integration tests for kernel handoff (prefill->decode) with KV cache preserved and no correctness regressions
Doc page in Confluence describing probe cadence, stability windows, and rollback playbook
subtasks: Design offline profiling schema and storage for kernel catalog
Implement probe harness that runs microbench probes under cgroups and reports to local store
Add token-phase metadata to runtime request context
Implement PhaseAdvisor decision logic and safe-handoff protocol
Benchmark suite: create 10 mixed-workload scenarios with traffic replay
Kubernetes rollout job + canary metric checks

risks_and_mitigation: Risk: Online probes could add noise or cause transient tail latency — Mitigation: run probes in isolated cgroup with CPU cap and only during low-util windows or node warmup
Risk: Incorrect kernel handoff could corrupt KV cache semantics — Mitigation: conservative handoff protocol that validates KV-layout compatibility and falls back without dropping in-flight requests
Risk: Drift after driver update — Mitigation: include compiled-kernel checksum in catalog and invalidate entries when checksum changes; trigger automated re-profiling jobs
